caseName: Kedroff v. Saint Nicholas Cathedral of the Russian Orthodox Church in North America
caseNameFull: Kedroff v. Saint Nicholas Cathedral of the Russian Orthodox Church in North America
attorneys: Philip Adler argued the cause and filed a brief for appellants. Ralph Montgomery Arkush argued the cause and filed a brief for appellees.

opinions.text: This case is ordered restored to the docket for reargument. In view of the opinion, concurring opinion, dissent, judgment and re-mittitur of the Court of Appeals of New York concerning the status of the Patriarchate in Russia, counsel are requested to include in their presentation a discussion of whether the judgment may be sustained on state grounds.
